selectionPath.population: all generation-certified selected names on identifying multi-name dates
selectionPath.entryReference: formal selection close only as a common research baseline
selectionPath.meaning: tests whether capital tilt points toward names with better subsequent paths

prerequisites: Confirmed Fill Ledger Class-B implementation with planScanDate + ledgerEpoch coverage
proof that BUY trigger timing/eligibility is allocator-invariant or explicit counterfactual trigger model
counterfactual share sizing under the comparator
fees, tax, odd-lot/minimum-fee and slippage treatment
untriggered planned capital treated as cash, not as if invested

relationship: Selection-path evidence may show predictive score ordering but cannot by itself establish deployable economic value. Execution evidence answers realized capital efficiency but is conditional on trigger/fill coverage. Both are required before sizing promotion.
triggerBiasCorrection: BUY-only is not a substitute for the all-selected predictive estimand. For realized allocation economics, BUY/fill conditioning is necessary, but it becomes a separate execution-clock estimand and requires coverage/invariance checks rather than being mixed with the selection-path cohort.
costRule: Costs belong to the execution clock. Do not subtract guessed trading costs from a formal-close paper-path edge and call the result realized net P&L.
timestampProvenance: Corrected to GitHub PR creation time; do not use prior manually estimated clock value as evidence ordering.
